messages:
Ava M: Quick heads-up — we're migrating /blog -> /resources next week. Need an SEO + redirects checklist before deploy. TL;DR: keywords, redirects, canonicals, sitemap, schema for webinar landing, internal links.

Jon C: I'll own the redirects map. Can someone share the list of top-performing blog URLs? :eyes:

Priya S: I can export GA4 top pages this afternoon and tag by sessions/conversions. Also we should map old keywords to new topic pages (consolidation).

Sam T: Reminder — use 301s for permanent moves. Avoid meta refresh/JS-only redirects. Also include rules for trailing slashes, www vs non-www, and case normalization.

Ava M: Priority checklist (short):
1) Redirect map (CSV) + regex patterns for platform
2) Canonical tags updated on new pages
3) Sitemap.xml regenerated & submitted to Search Console
4) JSON-LD: Event + FAQ for webinar landing
5) Internal linking updates (product -> resources)
6) GA/GTM path updates and goal verification
7) Staging crawl + redirect test

Jon C: I'll create the redirect CSV. Proposed format: `old_url,new_url,status,notes`
Sample: `https://redwood.example.com/blog/llm-costs,https://redwood.example.com/resources/optimization-guide,301,consolidated`

Priya S: Keyword consolidation plan: group "LLM inference costs", "inference cost optimization", "reduce token spend" under /resources/optimization-guide. I'll draft meta title + 160-char meta desc suggestions.

Sam T: For webinar landing schema — use Event + FAQ. Quick JSON-LD snippet for Event (we'll tweak fields):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Reducing LLM Inference Costs",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T16:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-04-15T17:00:00Z",
  "eventAttendanceMode": "https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode",
  "url": "https://redwood.example.com/resources/webinar-llm-costs"
}
```

Ava M: Good. Add FAQ schema for common registration/Q&A items too. Also: during a canary we can keep canonical pointing to new URL, but make sure the redirect is in place after launch.

SEO Bot: Reminder — run a staging crawl with Screaming Frog + check HTTP status codes and follow redirects. Also run Lighthouse for SEO checklist.

Priya S: I'll update the content calendar and notify authors about canonical decisions. Adding tracking task: update GTM to fire event `webinar_reg` on new path.

Jon C: Will push redirect CSV to /ops/redirects/ and open a PR with deploy instructions. Ping me for any complex regex patterns (I can test on staging).

Sam T: One more note — ensure hreflang tags preserved if any translations. Double-check AMP pages (if exist) and update canonical/hreflang there too.

Ava M: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Let's do a quick sync in 30 to walk the checklist and assign final owners for each item.
